apps.name: DLTwitter
apps.localizedDescription:
Requires a license. EOL for iOS 14.x. I will no longer be able to test new IPAs. For the last iOS 14 compatible version of BHTwitter, grab it from the 02-11-2023 release. Kinda like DLTikTok, for Twitter. Features include downloading videos, confirm follows & likes/unlikes, disabling typing indicator in DMs, browsing accounts that blocked you, remove ads, etc. Update this from other sources at your own risk, it's a pain in the ass to get it working if a newer version gives you the "unlicensed" error. I test these IPAs myself before uploading.
Last updated: 08-14-2024
Status: ✅

apps.name: DLTikTokLRD
apps.localizedDescription:
There is a chance this only works properly via TrollStore, otherwise you may run into the "unlicesned" error in the DLTikTok settings. TikTok injected with both DLTikTok and TikTokLRD! Saving slideshow images without a watermark is broken. DLTikTok needs an update for this for newer versions of TikTok. For now, use the TikPhoto shortcut to save them without a watermark
Last updated: 04-13-2023

apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.subtitle: GameCube and Wii games on the go.
apps.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Fixes crashing when starting a game
- Fixes graphical problems caused by an Apple silicon GPU driver bug
- Integrates support for AltJIT and JitStreamer
- Adds rumble when using the Touchscreen controller on iPhones

For more information, see https://oatmealdome.me/blog/dolphinios-ver-3-2-0/.

apps.name: Delta iPac Edition
apps.subtitle: A sneak peek preview of Delta!
apps.localizedDescription:
# iPac Edition Official Release

Only the IPA is included. The "Source Code" is merely the README.

New Features:
* Optimized AirPlay Support
* Local Mulitplayer (NES, SNES, N64, GEN)
* Nintendo-Switch-Online-like Rewind
* Additional MFi Inputs (L3, R3, Options, Home, and some PS/Xbox-specific inputs)
* External Controller deadzones for analog inputs (allows analog sticks to work properly for d-pads)
* External Controller connection now prevents game screen from rotating
* SNES Audio no longer crackles
* Bonus: Quick Saves now Sync
